set.body: Freeze the smallest Oderskyan public contract before refactoring: immutable CodecProgram and stage ADTs, distinct metadata compilation and executable runtime capabilities, exact representation transitions, ownership and decoded-length rules, typed missing-capability failures, and separate synchronous JVM versus asynchronous Scala.js interpreters without introducing a universal effect abstraction. Inventory the current public API and specify a source migration path for SyncGzipCapability and hard-coded browser/writer execution. Gate: an inspectable API sketch, explicit invariants and non-goals, and no neuroimaging concepts in the generic contract.
set.title: Zarr Z6.0: freeze the executable codec contract
